alsoGreen.intent: Structured Text instead of Ladder: the same stand-in, the same scaling and the same two comparisons
the high level lamp uses GT with 74 instead of GE with 75, which is the same for a whole number

wrong.intent: divides before it multiplies, so the integer division gives 0 for every count below 4095
compares the raw counts with 75 instead of the percentage, so the lamp rises on the first scan
multiplies by 10 instead of 100, so the percentage never reaches the limits
